Name: Paddy Fields
Author: hadiwrites42
Description:
Have you ever found paddy crops to be more nuisance than boon?

Hated having to find a decent water source for planting them, or going out of your way to set up ponds/wells for rice and taro?

Well, now you can commission a new 'building' from Robin that creates a dedicated paddy field on your farm! No need to add a water source, it already IS one!

Plant your paddy crops in neat, organized plots like the rest of your fields, with built in skins for borders you can order from Robin if you don't like the bare look! (or if you don't feel like building your own).

[b][u]New in 1.2.0:
[/u][/b]
- Removed AT pack and made bordered paddies a skin you can choose in Robin's menu!
- The choice between blank center tiles and watering hole decor is now configurable!
[list]
[*]         Set [font=Courier New]"PassableCenterTile"[/font] to [font=Courier New]"true"[/font] for blank and passable (unfortunately not tillable, but if you have a mod like Anything Anywhere, you can definitely put scarecrows or decor here!) and [font=Courier New]"false"[/font] for the small, cute watering hole!
[/list]- Fixed an issue with the watering hole not appearing in seasonal versions
- Added an [font=Courier New]"auto"[/font] option to the color config if you want it to automatically set the color based on if you play vanilla or with recolors (supports DNER, Starblue, and VPR). If you use another recolor that isn't automatically detected, you can also choose between [font=Courier New]"vanilla"[/font] and [font=Courier New]"muted"[/font] manually!

[b]
[/b][i]Special thanks to mushymato for setting up the base patch and yeeting the issues out! (I just added art and fine-tuned some of the details).[/i]

Downloads.Description: Removed a redundant drawlayer and changed the way the patch adds borders. Delete old files before updating!
